statement.text:
Let (G, τ ) be a topological group with finite semigroup τ (G) of ultrafilters
converging to the identity (I. V. Protasov, Siberian Math. J., 34, no. 5 (1993), 938–
951). Is it true that τ (G) is a semigroup of idempotents?
   Comment of 2005: This is proved for G countable (E. G. Zelenyuk, Mat. Studii,
14 (2000), 121–140).                                                   E. G. Zelenyuk
